fusions.name: Embers on the Current
fusions.desc: Looses 3 burning polyps at once, spread apart, each dealing 26 fire damage, setting the target [Burning] for 5 seconds and bursting for 80% of that on every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Stinging Brush
fusions.desc: A brushing touch that deals 4 fire damage and leaves the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scalding Skin
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Kiln-Hardened
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 12% fire resistance.
